style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, orange swim goggles pushed up on his forehead, no snorkel, beak always uncovered, YELLOW swim ring 65 round his waist. Calm, serious. Never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, white hanky. ONE beaver, ORANGE helmet. Background only: clerks with briefcases: rabbit, badger, fox.
props: Beach lounger, cocktail glass, red-white striped beach umbrella, sunscreen tube: goose's. Door poster, top view of blue sea, round sand island, one striped umbrella, no text: mole's. Shovel: beaver's.
environment: Mint-green office stairs, white hall, glass exit door with the poster. Behind it a sunny site: yellow fence, ochre sand, a deep round pit with a blue puddle.
lighting: Midday sun fills the pit; warm key on the goose's face, magenta rim left, cyan rim right. Blue vest, yellow ring, striped umbrella vivid in every shot, close-ups too.

light_events.event: sun bursts through the torn poster

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose only, dry deadpan adult voice 0.5-7.5 s, beak free while speaking

timeline.a: From the first frame: goose lies on the lounger head-first, sledding down the stairs past clerks walking up; on top the mole, foot still out, waves his hanky.
timeline.c: plunges down the stairs after him

timeline.a: Lounger skids across the hall at the glass door; the sea poster grows ahead.
timeline.c: skims his shoulder, goose in foreground

timeline.a: Goose drops the goggles over his eyes only, raises the glass in his left wing to the poster like a toast; beak free.
timeline.c: whips round into his face, close-up

timeline.a: Lounger nose hits the poster; at the end it tears; behind it no sea: fence, sand, a pit.
Lounger flies over the edge, lands in the puddle; goose floats on his ring, wings flick open, fold.
Goose stays: sets the lounger on a mud bump mid-puddle, opens his striped umbrella over it; beak free.
timeline.c: arcs round him, umbrella in foreground

timeline.a: Goose lies under the umbrella, smears sunscreen from the tube in his right wing on his belly; beak free.
timeline.c: rolls onto its back in mud

timeline.a: Beaver at the rim lowers his shovel to the goose's raised empty right wing, lifts it onto his shoulder, turns away; beak free.
timeline.c: swings up to the blade, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver, not looking, flings a shovel of sand into the pit; it hits the umbrella, slides off and rings the lounger as an island: from above, the door poster exactly.
Goose under the umbrella raises the glass in his left wing at the lens.
At the door the mole's paws stick a new identical poster over the hole. Last frame: mole's paw on the poster corner.
timeline.c: rockets back through the door, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, night, dark scene, floating objects, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
